success.description: M You alter how an item (or small group of items, such as a handful of coins) is perceived. Silver looks like gold, fine wine tastes like vinegar, a worthless bauble seems like a priceless artefact, and so on. This spell only works on inanimate objects and lasts until the end of the encounter. Suspicious people can see through your illusion with a successful Observation (Int) check opposed by your Spellcraft (Int) + {Dc}.

boon.description: M The quality of the illusion is unusually high. Anyone attempting to see through it must add {Dm} to his dice pool.

chaosStar.description: The arrow-shaped mark of Ulgu appears somewhere on the item, clear evidence of tampering to those with sufficient knowledge.

conservative.requirements: 4 power, medium range to the item
